header.autoSaveNotice: Your progress is automatically saved while you work.

upload.title: Upload
upload.description: Upload your video and let the system prepare every asset needed for processing.
upload.pageDescription: Upload your video to begin automated speech transcription and processing.
upload.dropzoneDescription: Upload MP4, MOV, MKV, AVI or other supported video formats.
upload.autoDetectionNote: The original language will be detected automatically.
upload.translateToHint: Select the language you want the video content to be translated into.
upload.autoDetectDescription: The system will automatically identify the spoken language in your video.

transcript.title: Transcript
transcript.description: Automatically transcribe speech, detect speakers, and preserve timestamps.
transcript.emptyTranscript: No transcript available for this video yet. Open Whisper Options and click 'Start Whisper Transcription' to begin.

translation.title: Translation
translation.description: Translate dialogue while keeping context, terminology, and speaker structure.
translation.noTranslation: No translation available for {{lang}} yet. Open Translation Options and click 'Start Translation' to begin.
translation.retranslateMessage: This will retranslate all dialogue and overwrite any manual edits made to existing lines. Are you sure you want to continue?

subtitle.title: Subtitle
subtitle.description: Generate accurate, time-synchronized subtitles ready for review and export.
subtitle.pageDescription: Customize subtitle format and preview the translated subtitles before exporting.

dubbing.title: Dubbing
dubbing.description: Convert translated dialogue into natural-sounding speech while preserving speaker flow.

reviewExport.title: Review & Export
reviewExport.description: Review the generated content, make corrections, and export subtitles, documents, or the final video.
reviewExport.pageDescription: Review your processed video, adjust the timeline, and select the files you want to export.
reviewExport.timelineSubtitle: Review and adjust your processed content.
reviewExport.exportSuccess: Export successful! Your browser is downloading the file.
reviewExport.videoNotCreatedWarning: Final video has not been rendered at Step 5.
reviewExport.emptyDescription: You need to render the AI dubbed video at Step 5 before you can preview and download here.
reviewExport.backToDubbing: Back to Step 5: Dubbing to render video
reviewExport.loadingPreviewDesc: System is preparing the streaming playback for your finalized video.
reviewExport.downloadTooltipReady: Download finished file to your computer
reviewExport.downloadTooltipNotReady: Need to render dubbed video in Step 5 before downloading
